data.body:
2bc9 claimed after remediated plan-review PASS. Test contract card:
authoritative_contract: ticket 2bc9 ACs + parent 1c1b D3/D5/D7; existing push-only contract in push.py.
trigger_preconditions: canonical real tracker; dirty/clean-ahead/recovery-marker/faulted lock-stage-commit/competing-remote states asserted before call.
production_path: commit_and_push_tickets_branch -> existing lock/guard/git seams -> push_tickets_branch; private module CLI for process behavior.
test_tier: real temporary git repos and refs; real CLI subprocess; existing two-clone deterministic competitor harness (unit-only is insufficient for reachability/identity/concurrency).
observable_postcondition: exact commit subject/author, clean or retained dirty state, local/remote reachability, no empty commit, typed reason or CLI stderr/nonzero.
negative_control: direct push_tickets_branch stays push-only; ambient identity remains; default failures warn/return.
collateral_invariants: existing git config unchanged; local commit/content retained on failure; no push after commit-phase failure; both competing commits reachable.
recovery: remove recovery marker or injected failure and prove retry commits/pushes retained content.
fault_injection: existing write_lock and _git stage/commit seams; competing real push just before A's first push.
ci_gate: focused pytest nodes plus make lint/typecheck/test. Surface parity: private module CLI and shared core in scope; public library/MCP/workflows out of scope because entrypoint is internal and initially unused; push-only automated callers are continuity controls; dual direction covers commit+push versus push-only.
